en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
I've gotten used to being here...
I want to get outside as soon as I can...
Staying here forever wouldn't be so bad
Well, I guess that's the same for me too...

But, don't think it's okay to stay here
forever.

We're trapped in this place without
even knowing why...
It's just not possible!

Right!? There are so many things I wanna
do once we escape!

Listening to new music...
Playing my piano...

Yeah! I'm getting excited just thinking
about it!
Let's get out of this dumb academy!

What are you saying!?
You definitely can't stay here!

We gotta work together and find a way
out of here, okay!?

I assumed you felt the same way as
me, but...you don't, do you?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kaede looks deep in thought...
(*sigh*)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kaede's inner thoughts...?
